messages:
alex: Tiny shoutout: @tess swooped in this morning when the client demo audio went quiet. fixed the mix and also rescued the office ficus from dehydration. multitasking royalty :crown: :plant:
maya: omg the ficus was on death watch, bless tess. and the demo audio was 🔥 after that fix.
sanjay: seriously, saved the handoff. shout to @tess and also props to @alex for spotting the audio spike early. quick triage = win. :raised_hands:
tess: haha, just happened to be walking by and saw the panicked faces. teamwork! also, left a small stash of lemon poppy croissants in the kitchen for the crew. :croissant: :sparkles:
alex: note to self: always have tess nearby. recommend giving a ‘sticker salute’ and a coffee of choice. vote below with emoji. :point_down:
maya: :medal: (stickers pls)
sanjay: :coffee: = decaf please, and :medal: for tess
kudos-bot: recorded: recipient=tess points=4 reason="demo audio fix + plant rescue"
akex: oops typo on username but yes congrats!
alex: love the bot receipts. can someone add this to the kudos sheet? link it to Q2 team morale fund.
kudos-bot: added: "tess — demo/audio + plant CPR (4)" to #kudos-log https://docs.example.com/kudos-log
maya: tiny gathering at 2:30 by the snacks? quick sticker ceremony and coffee run.
tess: i'll bring the bad acceptance speech and stickers. fair warning. :grin:
sanjay: i'll grab decaf + oat. see you then!"
